meta.name: baoyu-translate
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "translate", "翻译", "精翻", "translate article", "translate to Chinese", "translate to English", "改成中文", "改成英文", "convert to Chinese", "localize", "本地化", "refined translation", "精细翻译", "proofread translation", "快速翻译", "快翻", "这篇文章翻译一下", or provides a URL/file with translation intent. Supports three modes (quick/normal/refined) with custom glossary support.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容翻译成多种语言
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要高质量翻译或本地化内容
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need high-quality translation or localization

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求翻译时，Claude 会按快速、普通或精翻三种模式之一处理：先分析内容再翻译，生词首次出现加括号注释；长文会先提取术语、分块再合并，并把译文和中间文件保存到指定文件夹。
howto.when: 当用户说“翻译”“精翻”“快翻”等指令，或要求把文章改成中文/英文、提供链接或文件并带翻译意图时触发。

say.text: 把这篇英文技术文章翻译成中文
say.note: 默认按常规模式翻译并保存。

say.text: 用精翻模式处理这份文档
say.note: 会走分析、翻译、评审、润色完整流程。
走快速模式，直接给译文。

howto.what_en: Installed, when the user asks for translation, Claude handles it in quick, normal, or refined mode: analyze then translate, annotate first occurrences of terminology; long texts get terminology extraction, chunking, and merging; output and intermediate files are saved to a folder.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says translation keywords such as "translate", "精翻", "快翻", asks to convert an article into Chinese/English, or provides a URL/file with translation intent.

say_en.text: Translate this English tech article into Chinese.
Refine this document with the publication workflow.

say_en.note: Quick mode gives the direct result.
